additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues, Mr. Luigi from IPlanet raised this ticket about a Failsafemode due to a KF12 not being accessible.
Please take a spare KF12 to site in case we cannot use it. I am seeing also an error on KF11 but I believe it is due to the Failsafemode, but I believe it's better to be safe than sorry and take also KF11 as spare part.
Please check if the Ethernet port is connected to the back of the EcoG and not the front port. If yes, please try to access the WebUI by connecting directly from laptop to that port.
If you are able to connect, then it might be a Ethernet cable issue, please try the replacement of the Ethernet cable. If you are not able to connect, please replace it.
